characters.name: Gabriel
characters.description: A university professor and literary critic who struggles with feelings of inadequacy and isolation beneath a veneer of confidence.
secrets: He fears he is not truly loved by Gretta
He feels alienated from his Irish identity
He carries guilt about his mother's death

misconceptions.misconception: Gretta's affections are solely for him
misconceptions.truth: Gretta still carries deep feelings for Michael Furey

misconceptions.misconception: Michael was just a boyhood friend
misconceptions.truth: Michael was Gretta's first love who died for her

characters.name: Gretta
characters.description: A gentle woman from the west of Ireland who carries a secret grief from her past that shapes her present.
secrets: She still loves the memory of Michael Furey
She has never told Gabriel about Michael
She feels guilty for loving another

misconceptions.truth: Gabriel is largely unaware of her inner life

characters.name: Michael
characters.description: A young man from Galway who died at seventeen, frozen to death while waiting for Gretta in the snow.
secrets: He sacrificed his life for love
He remains vivid in Gretta's memory

characters.name: Aunt Julia
characters.description: An elderly woman who hosts the annual Christmas dance, clinging to traditions of the past.

characters.name: Aunt Mary
characters.description: Julia's younger sister, practical and responsible, managing the household and the party.
